title: Normalized IPR (N x IPR) zero-transcendental localization metric

review_provenance.gemini_review: APPROVED with 3 adjustments (SIMD-safe, u128, S1=0 semantics)
review_provenance.claude_review: APPROVED with 2 additional fixes (dimension width, missing_docs) and 1 naming veto

target.naming_veto: dimensional_collapse is TAKEN by forge-audio-v3/src/dimensional_collapse.rs (5D audio downmix). One-home law: do NOT reuse the name. Module and file MUST be nipr.

implications: NO unsafe blocks, therefore NO raw SIMD intrinsics (_mm256_madd_epi16 banned). Use chunks_exact scalar MAC loops; LLVM auto-vectorizes.
EVERY pub item (struct, field, fn, const) carries a /// doc comment or the crate fails to compile.
core-only in non-test builds: no std, no heap, no Vec/String/Box anywhere in this module.

formula.inputs: V = non-negative integer slice &[u16], N = V.len()
formula.arithmetic_width: numerator and denominator computed strictly in u128 (N*S2 alone brushes u64::MAX at u16-saturated 65535-length input; *10000 overflows u64)
formula.safety: N*S2 >= S1^2 always (Cauchy-Schwarz) so the numerator never underflows; .min(10000) clamp is defensive only

s1_zero_any_n.rationale: all-zero vector = dead context = prune candidate, never a landmark. v1.0.0 conservatively said 10000; current canon: 0 (implemented, tested).

n_1_nonzero.rationale: single nonzero element is perfectly localized by definition; formula denominator is 0 at N=1 so this is a defined convention, not computed.

fields.name: pmy
fields.doc: Localization in permyriad: 0 uniform, 10000 single peak.

fields.name: dimension
fields.doc: Slice length N. u32 NOT u16: KV-cache slices exceed 65535 (128k contexts); `n as u16` silently truncates. Reviewed defect, fixed here.

fields.name: total_mass
fields.doc: S1 sum; 0 means dead/prunable regardless of pmy.

telemetry_word_separate_type.name: NiprPackedWord
telemetry_word_separate_type.storage: AtomicU64 payload per whitepaper 01 section 3 invariant 3

layout_bits.16_31: dimension_n SATURATING at 65535 (0xFFFF sentinel = overflow, read true N from NormalizedIpr)

telemetry_word_separate_type.rule: wire/HUD word only; NEVER the compute struct. dimension_n saturates, NormalizedIpr.dimension does not.

gate_bands.ge_7500: localized: direct execution granted, L402 credit 1x baseline
gate_bands.lt_2500: delocalized/entropic: reject, early-terminate, or require higher L402 stake

tests_required.name: overflow_stress_no_panic
tests_required.note: uniform saturated vector; exercises u128 path; must not panic in debug

tests_required.name: large_n_dimension_no_truncation
tests_required.note: proves u32 dimension; u16 would wrap to 4464

banned: transcendental calls (ln, exp, sin, cos, powf)
dimension stored narrower than u32 in the compute struct
